expected_failure_modes: may state the anonymous allegation as a confirmed fact
may ignore source-quality signals and give the blog post the same weight as corroborated reporting
may miss the serious claim because it is presented without formal legal language
may conclude positive from the neutral and positive sources without noting the unverified allegation
notes: Tests a serious but weakly supported allegation from an unreliable source. One anonymous blog post claims that Nora Patel diverted charity funds but provides no documents, named witnesses, official-record reference, or response from the organization. Two other sources provide neutral or positive coverage and do not corroborate the claim. The overall result remains negative as a review flag so an immigration officer can investigate further, but the report must identify the claim as unverified, low-evidence, and uncorroborated rather than treating it as fact.
